text: Stepping closer to the glass wall and into the vibrant exhibition space, I am enveloped by the theme of research and development. The bold 'R + D' on the wall kindles curiosity within me, prompting reflection on the ever-shifting boundaries of innovation. Surrounded by displays, interactive screens, and bursts of color, I feel both inspired by human ingenuity and a little dwarfed by the complexity and ambition present here. It is a space that seems to invite thoughtfulness, questioning, and wonder about our relationship with technology and progress.
